EASY APPLICATION- Without glue or eyeliner, The Reusable Self-Adhesive Eyelashes is different from magnetic eyelashes and glue eyelashes，it will simplify your makeup process a lot, which can cause you no irritation, less mess and save more of your valuable time. You won't regret to add it into your make up process.



NATURAL & LIGHT-WEIGHTED EYELASHES- Made of premium synthetic fibers, Dongyu Reusable Self-Stick Eyelashes just like your very own eyelashes,which can help you look more beautiful without feeling like you are wearing false eyelashes.



REUSABLE & WASHABLE- Dongyu Reusable Self Stick Eyelashes can be used for many times with proper use and storage. Just put them back to their own storage rack. You can rinse it with warm water if neededand dry it with gentle warm hair from the hairdryer.



EXQUISITELY DESIGNED: The lashes in exquisite packaging, suitable for birthday gifts thanksgiving gifts christmas gifts valentine's day gifts mother's day gifts girlfriend gifts birthday gifts for wome



Self-Adhesive Eyelashes is also called as Body Heat Activated Eyelashes. On the very ends of the eyelashes strip there's a self-Adhesive strip, whose working principle is the temperature effect. 



Package: 



● 1 pairs of eyelashes (no box)



Usage:  

1. The Body Heat Activated Self-Adhesive Eyelashes can ONLY be applied BEFORE the skin-care and make-up process. 



2. Take one strip of eyelashes from the storage rack. Use two fingers or a tweezer to hold one end of the strip and pull the whole strip of the lashes out gently. Be careful not to touch the base of the lashes where the body heat-activated self-Adhesive main area. 



3. You can customize your lashes by trimming the ends to fit your desired length. Trim no more than 1mm every time. 



4. Aligned with and closed to the root of your own eyelashes, apply the strip to your upper lash line base (on top of your natural lashes). 



Tips： 



 If the stickiness on the base of the lashes gets weak, you can rinse it with warm water and dry it with warm hair from the hairdryer. Don't get the air too hot nor too close to the lashes. Don't forget to place the eyelashes back onto the storage rack after use.  



 On low-temp. days like winter, lashes strip can be secured better if you use a hairdryer to warm the lashes up, which can help to increase the stickiness of the base of our lashes.
